Blackhead

A monorepo template designed to have everything you need to build your new SaaS app as thoroughly as possible. Free and open source, forever

$

npx blackhead@latest init
Get Started
/apps/web
Priceless app template

Starting template with everything you need to build a modern web app.

/apps/api
Cross-platform API

Create an API microservice for many different apps, with a type-safe database ORM and webhook handlers.

/packages/ui
Design system

A design system with reusable components, themes, and styles for consistent branding.
